<entry id="M02225">
<head-word>מְפַנַּק</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (part. pass. of פְּנַק) 
<italic>brought up in wealth, delicate, fastidious</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. IV, 3; a. e.—Keth. 67
<sup>b</sup> מ' כולי האי is he used to such comforts?—B. Kam. 84
<sup>a</sup> איכא איניש דמ' וכ' one man is delicate and feels pain more intensely, another is hardened &c.; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְפַנְקִין, מְפַנְקֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Is. XLIV, 4; a. e.—Ḥag. 4
<sup>a</sup> sq. לאתויי מ' to include delicate persons (that do not walk barefooted). Sabb. 109
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Fem. מְפַנְּקָא, מְפַנַּקְתָּא. Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 56 (Y. מפרנקא). Targ. Is. XLVII, 8; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְפַנְקָתָא, מְפַנְקָאתָא</plural-form>. Targ. Lam. IV, 3.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02226">
<head-word>מְפַנְּקָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>

<entry id="M02227">
<head-word>מְפַנְקוּ</head-word>
<head-word>מְפַנְקוּתָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>good breeding; delicacy, fastidiousness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 56 ed. Berl. (Ms. I מִתְפַּנְקוּ, some ed. אתפנקו, v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 58; Y. פרניקא).—Pes. 50
<sup>b</sup> משום מ' הוא it is merely because they are used to indulgence (idleness). Ḥag. 6
<sup>a</sup> חנה מ' יתירתא וכ' Hannah saw in Samuel extraordinary tenderness (saw that he was a very delicate child).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02239">
<head-word>מַפְקָנָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נְפַק) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> = h. מוֹצָא, 
<italic>coming forth</italic>; מ' דמיא 
<italic>spring;</italic> (of a building) 
<italic>exit</italic>; (of troops) 
<italic>exodus, march</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Kings II, 21.—
<plural-form>Pl. מַפְקָנִין</plural-form>. Targ. Ps. CXXVI, 4.—Targ. Ez. XLII, 11. Targ. Num. XXXIII, 2 (ed. Berl. מַפְּ'; Y. ed. Vien. מִפְ'); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>discharge</italic> from the bowels.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 56
<sup>b</sup>, v. מַעֲלָנָא.—V. מַפַּקְתָּא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02240">
<head-word>מַפְקָנוּתָא</head-word>

<sense>

<definition>
<italic>that which comes forth, sprouting</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XXXVIII, 27.—Targ. Ps. LXXXIX, 35 (Targ. O. Deut. XXIII, 24 אַפָּקוּת).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>going out, leaving</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ex. XXI, 7 (ed. Vienna מַפְּ'). Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 21 מפקנות נשמתא death.—V. next w.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02249">
<head-word>מִפְרֵעַ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פָּרַע) 
<italic>upsetting</italic>; לְמִ' (adv.; cmp. הפך) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>irregularly, out of order</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. II, 1 הקורא … למ' he who reads the Book of Esther in an irregular way (corresp. to סירוסין, ib. 18
<sup>b</sup> top). Ib. 17
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Esth. IX, 27) מה זמנם למ' לא אף כתבם למ' לא as you cannot disregard the order of these days in celebrating their season, so you must not transpose the order in which the events of these days are described. Ib. (ref. to Esth. IX, 28) מה עשייה למ' לא אף זכירה למ' לא as you cannot subvert the celebration, so you must not subvert the order of recitation. Ber. 13
<sup>a</sup>; Sot. 32
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>backward, retroactively, retrospectively</italic>, opp. מכאן ולהבא.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 27
<sup>a</sup> למ' הוא נפסל he becomes disqualified as witness retroactively, i.e. his testimonies are invalidated from the time that he perjured himself (opp. מיכן ולהבא, v. בָּא III). Erub. 37
<sup>b</sup>, sq … ונמצא … למ' and the retroactive result would be that he drank untithed wine at the time; Y. Dem. VII, 26
<sup>b</sup> למִפְרֵעוֹ. Y. Gitt. III, end, 45
<sup>b</sup> למפרעו הוא נעשה חומץ is it to be considered as sour wine at the time, i.e. from the day that he was bound to examine it? Tosef. Sot. XI, 9 מְנֵה … למ' count thirty-three days backward. Gen. R. s. 49 חזור בך למ' take up the argument going back gradually (from fifty to forty-five &c.); a. fr.—Tosef. Ber. IV, 19, sq. לברך למ' to say the blessing after meal, opp. כתחלה(ל); Pes. 101
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02250">
<head-word>מַפְרַעְתָּא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פְּרע I) 
<italic>tearing open</italic>, esp. (sub. בית) 
<italic>the place of the abdomen which the butcher strikes when tearing the peritoneum</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 50
<sup>b</sup> (expl. כרס הפנימי) מ' (some ed. מַפְרַעְתָּהּ).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02251">
<head-word>מִפְרֵק</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>joint</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. constr. מִפְרְקֵי</plural-form>. Naz. 52
<sup>b</sup> מ' ידים וכ' the joints of arms and legs.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02252">
<head-word>מִפְרֶקֶת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> preced.; cmp. אַפְקוֹתָא)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>that which branches off</italic>,] 
<italic>neck, nape</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 113
<sup>a</sup> השובר מִפְרַקְתָּהּ וכ' he who breaks the neck of a slaughtered animal before it is dead. Zeb. 65
<sup>b</sup> חותך שדרה ומ' he cuts (with his nail) the spinal column and the nape; Ḥull. 21
<sup>a</sup>; 28
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. 10
<sup>b</sup> (in Chald. dict.) בעצם דמ' איפגים the knife may have been notched on striking the neck-bone; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02253">
<head-word>מְפָרֵשׁ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="Q01908">פָּרַשׁ</xref>) 
<italic>one who undertakes a voyage.</italic></definition>
<notes> Gitt. VI, 5 המ' והיוצא וכ' one who starts for a sea voyage or a caravan journey.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְפָרְשִׁים</plural-form>.—מְפָרְשֵׁי הים, מ' ימים 
<italic>sea-farers</italic>. Y. Sabb. II, beg. 4
<sup>c</sup>, a. e. חיזרתי על כל מ' ימים I went around inquiring of all sea-faring people; (Bab. ib. 20
<sup>b</sup> נחותי ימא).—[In later Hebr. מ' 
<italic>commentator</italic>.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02254">
<head-word>מַפְשׁוּטִיתָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פְּשַׁט; v. 
<xref rid="Q00879">פִּישּׁוּט</xref>) 
<italic>stretching out</italic> hands and feet, 
<italic>prostration at prayers</italic> (= h. הִשְׁתַּחֲוָיָה).</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 43
<sup>d</sup> top מ' דתעניתא וערובתא וכ' the prostration on fast days (that it must not be done on stone floors, v. ib., a. Meg. 22
<sup>b</sup>), and the arrangement of the calendar with regard to the seventh day of Succoth (that it should not fall on the Sabbath), v. עֲדַבְתָּא; Y. Shebi. I, 33
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Y. Succ. IV, beg. 54
<sup>b</sup> מַפְשִׁיטוּ'.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02255">
<head-word>מִפְתָּח</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> פָּתַח)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>opening, entrance</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mikv. VIII, 1 חוץ למ' (Var. לפתח) outside of the (town) gate; Tosef. ib. VI, 1 (R. S. to Mikv. l. c. פתח).—Pesik. R. s. 37 מִפְתַּח שפתיו וכ' the opening of his lips is blessing and peace. Sabb. XV, 2 (111
<sup>b</sup>) מ' חלוקה (Y. ed. מפתחי) the neekhole of her shirt; Y. ib. 15
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. מִפְתָּחִים,</plural-form> constr. מִפְתְּחֵי. Ber. 61
<sup>a</sup> bot. יה"ר דומה … בין שני מ' הלב man’s evil inclination resembles a fly and is seated between the two valves of the heart; Yalk. Koh. 979; Yalk. Gen. 38.—מ' חלוק, v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02284">
<head-word>מִצְוָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> צָוָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>command</italic>, esp. 
<italic>religious act, meritorious deed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 141
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. לדבר מ' for a religious purpose, opp. לדבר הרשות for a secular or religiously indifferent purpose.—מלחמת מ' v. מִלְחָמָה.—Ab. IV, 11 מ' אחת one good deed, opp. עֲבֵרָה sin. Ib. שכר מ' מ' the reward of a good deed is another good deed, v. גָּרַר. Ib. II, 1 מ' קלה a light command (obeyed with little sacrifice); Ned. 39
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—מ' הבאה בעבירה a religious act achieved through a wrong deed, e. g. using an illegitimately obtained object for a religious ceremony. Succ. 30
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. XIII, 14
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Y. Ḥall. I, end, 58
<sup>a</sup> אין עבירה מ' no-sin is virtue; אין מ' עבירה no-virtue is sin.—Zeb. 52
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מ' (sub. קרבן) an offering dependent on certain occasions as ordained in the Law, opp. חובה an obligatory offering (at regular seasons).—איסור מ', v. אִיסּוּר.—Y. Sot. I, beg. 16
<sup>b</sup> איתמרת למ' (או) לעיכוב is this said only as a recommendation or as an indispensable act?; Y. Pes. II, 29
<sup>b</sup> bot., a. fr., v. עִיכּוּב.—Ḥull. 106
<sup>a</sup> משום מ' because it is meritorious; מאי מ' מ' לשמוע וכ' what is the merit of it? It is meritorious to obey &c. Ib. לא חובה ולא מ' אלא רשות neither an obligatory, nor a meritorious, but a religiously indifferent act; Sabb. 25
<sup>b</sup>.—מִצְוַת עֲשֵׁה (abbr. מ"ע) 
<italic>a positive command;</italic> מ' לא תעשה 
<italic>a prohibition</italic>. Kidd. I, 7; a. v. fr., v. גְּרָמָא, a. לֹא, לַאו.—מת מ' the corpse of a person whose relatives are unknown and whose burial is obligatory on everybody. Hor. 13
<sup>a</sup> פגע בהם מת מ' they struck upon a corpse; a. fr.—M. Kat. 20
<sup>a</sup> חמשה מתי מ' the five relations (besides father and mother) whom one is obliged to bury (Lev. XXI, 2, sq.).—Lev. R. s. 34 תן לי מ' give 
<pgbrk id="pg824" />me what thou art commanded to, i.e. 
<italic>alms</italic>, v. next w.—
<plural-form>Pl. מִצְוֹת, מִצְווֹת</plural-form>. Macc. 23
<sup>b</sup> שש מאות … מ' six hundred and thirteen commands (positive and prohibitive). Y. Sabb. l. c.; Y. Ḥall. l. c. (ref. to אלה המצות, Lev. XXVII, 34) אם עשיתן כְּמִצְוָותָן מ' וכ' if thou doest them as they are commanded, they are deeds of merit &c. R. Hash. 28
<sup>b</sup> מ' אינו עובר עליהן אלא בזמנן one violates the law by adding to the prescribed form of ceremonies only when executed in their due season (e. g. one does not violate the law by dwelling in the Succah on the eighth day). Ib. מ' אין צריכות כונה; Ber. 13
<sup>a</sup> מ' צריכות כ', v. כַּוָּנָה. Succ. 39
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. כל המ' כולן מברך וכ' the benediction at the performance of religious ceremonies must precede the act. Nidd. 61
<sup>b</sup> מ' בטלות לע"ל ceremonial laws find no application in the hereafter (e. g. a dead body may be wrapped in

<entry id="M02306">

<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. מְטֵי)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to reach; to find</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. I, 1 אניּ מְצָאתִיהָ I found it. Ib. 2
<sup>a</sup> הואי אמינא מאי מצאתיה ראיתיה וכ' I might have thought ‘I found it’ meant ‘I discovered it’, although he had not taken it up &c. Ib., a. e. וּמְצָאתָהּ דאתאי לידיה וכ' ‘and which thou hast found’ (Deut. XXII, 3) means that it came into his possession. Gitt. IX, 10 מ' בה דבר ערוה he discovered in her something disgraceful (infidelity); מ' אחרת וכ' he found another woman handsomer than she; a. fr.—מה מָצִינוּ ב־ … אף וכ' what do we find with regard to—? So also &c., i.e. 
<italic>as in the case of—, so</italic> &c. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. VIII, Par. 7 מה מצינו בהקטרה … אף מליקה וכ' as when burning (the sacrifice on the altar) the head is separated from the trunk, so when pinching the neck of the bird the head must be severed &c.; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מָצוּי, f. מְצוּיָה; pl. מְצוּיִין; מְצוּיוֹת 
<italic>accessible, frequent; likely</italic>. Arakh. 30
<sup>b</sup> ומצא פרט למ' ‘and he find the means’ (Lev. XXV, 26), this excludes the case of the means being accessible, i.e. of one who had the means at the time being. B. Mets. 27
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Deut. XXII, 3, v. supra) מי שאבודה הימנו ומ' אצל וכ' that which is lost to him but accessible to any body else; אבודה הימנו ואינה מ' אצל וכ' lost to him and inaccessible to every one else (e. g. swept away by a flood). Sabb. 151
<sup>b</sup> עשה עד שאתה מוֹצֵא ומ' לך וכ' do good while thou findest (an opportunity), and it is possible to thee (thou hast the means), and thou art yet in thy own power (possessest thy faculties). Snh. 86
<sup>a</sup> כי ימצא פרט למ' ‘if one be found stealing &c.’ (Deut. XXIV, 7), this excludes the case when the abducted and sold person was in his power (his own child &c.). Ib. כמצויין בידו דמי the case is to be judged as if they (the children) had been in his possession. Gen. R. s. 85 השטר מ' להגבות the note can be produced for collection, i.e. evidence can be found against us. Gitt. 2
<sup>b</sup> אין עדים מ' לקיימו no witnesses are to be had to identify it. B. Mets. 18
<sup>a</sup> במקום שהשיירות מ' where caravans pass frequently. Esth. R. to I, 1, v. דִּידְכֵי. Ib. (ref. to Ps. XXI, 9) תהא ידך מ' ליפרע מאויביך thou shalt have the opportunity of punishing thy enemies. B. Kam. 4
<sup>a</sup> הזיקה מ' the damage through it is frequent. Ib. 60
<sup>a</sup> רוח מ' an ordinary wind, רוח שאינה מ' an extraordinary wind; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִמְצָא</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be found</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 85 שנִמְצְאוּ בגניבה who are caught at a theft; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>to turn out, to follow, to result</italic>. Ḥull. I, 4 נ' כשר וכ' the result is, what is legal in slaughtering is illegal in pinching. Pes. 25
<sup>b</sup> ונ' למד, v. לָמֵד II. Sifré Deut. 210 נִמְצִּינוּ למדים from which we can consequently derive.—Y. Pes. V, beg. 31
<sup>c</sup>, a. fr. נִמְצֵאתָ אומר thou turnest out saying, i.e. 
<italic>the result is, consequently</italic>.—אם תִּימָּצֵי (תִּמָּצֵא) לומר (abbr. את"ל) if you will say. Gitt. 82
<sup>b</sup> אם תמצא לומר איתא וכ' if you will adopt the opinion of &c. Sabb. 136
<sup>a</sup> את"ל פליגי וכ' if you assume that they differ &c.; a. fr.—Tosef. Ohol. IV, 12 כשתמצא לומר וכ' if you assume &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִמְצִיא</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to furnish, provide with</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. l. c. נאבדו וה' הקב"ה וכ' they (the tokens) had been lost, and the Lord provided others instead. Ḥag. 5
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to תמצאן, Deut. XXXI, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes> עבד שרבו מַמְצִיא וכ' what remedy is there for a slave for whom his master invents evils and troubles? Ib. הממציא לו מעות לעני וכ' he who is ready to furnish the means (of his delivery) to the poor man in distress (by which the persecutor’s greed is increased); [Rashi: he who has money ready for the poor man in extreme distress, instead of helping him to a livelihood in due time]. Arakh. 30
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Deut. XIX, 5) ומצא פרט לממציא את עצמו ‘and it strikes’, this excludes the case of one who brings himself within the range of the missile (after it is started); Macc. 8

<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to squeeze, wring, esp. to wring out the blood of the bird sacrifice</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. VIII, Par. 7 הוא מוֹצֶה he wrings it; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. Zeb. VI, 5, sq.; a. fr.—2) same.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to pour out to the last drop, to drain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 64
<sup>b</sup> מי כתיב יְמַצֶּה יִמָּצֵה וכ' (ed. punctuate יַמְצֶה, 
<italic>Hif.</italic>) it does not say (Lev. V, 9), ‘he shall pour out (the remainder) at the bottom &c.’, but ‘it shall be wrung out’, which means, that it will run out to the bottom of itself. Ter. XI, 8 הִרְכִּינָהּ ומִיצָּה (Y. ed. ומִיצֵּת; Ms. M. ומִצֵּת) if he bent the vessel and drained it; B. Bath. 87
<sup>b</sup> (Ms. H. a. R. ומיצת); ib. V, 8 (87
<sup>a</sup>) הרכינה ומיצה (Y. ed. ומצת; Bab. ed. ומִיצֵּית, Ms. M. ומִיצֵּת; Ms. R. ומִיצְּתָהּ). Gen. R. s. 85; s. 92 (play on מצא, Gen. XLIV, 16) כזה שהוא מְמַצֶּה וכ' as one drains a vessel and leaves nothing but the lees. Midr. Till. to Ps. LIX (play on מצא, Prov. XVIII, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> כשהאשה רעה היא מְמַצָּה (כל) הטובות כולן מביתו וכ' ed. Bub.</definition>
<notes> (oth. ed. ממַצֶּאֶת, a. oth. variants) when the wife is bad, she drains all the good things out of his house and makes him poor; Yalk. Prov. 957 ממציא (read: מְמַצֵּית); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (cmp. מָצַע) מ' מידות 
<italic>to measure exactly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. IV, 11 (52
<sup>b</sup>) אין המשוחות מְמַצִּין וכ' the surveyors (in marking distances for Sabbath limits) do not measure exactly (but mark within the limits), in order to allow for mistakes.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to sound one’s learning</italic>. Men. 18
<sup>a</sup> למַצֹּות מידותי to have my own learning examined; למ' מידותיו וכ' to sound the learning of &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>מִתְמַצֶּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be wrung out; to be emptied, drained</italic>
<pgbrk id="pg826" />Sifra Vayikra, Ḥob.</definition>
<notes>, Par. 10, ch. XVIII; Zeb. 64
<sup>b</sup> שהשירין מִתְמַצִּים ליסוד where the remainder is poured out towards the bottom of the altar; a. fr. [Ib. VI, 4 (64
<sup>b</sup>) היה מתמצה, read מְמַצֶּה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50.]—Y. R. Hash. I, 56
<sup>d</sup> top; Y. Shek. III, beg. 47
<sup>b</sup> עד כאן הן מִתְמַצּוֹת לילד וכ' up to that time (the first of Elul) the latest births of the old year (of those conceived before the first of Nisan) take place &c.—Trnsf. (with חשבון)
<italic> to be exactly counted, to be finally settled</italic>. Y. Sot. I, 17
<sup>a</sup> (he suffers a loss by the death of his ox &c.) והחשבון מִתְמַצֶּה and the account (of his sins) is settled; ib.; Num. R. s. 9 אחת מתארעא וכ', v. אָרַע I; Koh. R. to VII, 27.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
